Title: Guest workshop booking
Scenario (business language steps): Choose a configured session; provide required contact; pay deposit through gateway flow
Expected Business Outcome: Booking is confirmed only after valid payment confirmation

Title: Ready-ring retail
Scenario (business language steps): Choose a ready ring; complete full payment; choose pickup or carrier handoff
Expected Business Outcome: One ready ring is reserved after confirmed payment

Title: Member ring design and recommendation
Scenario (business language steps): Configure a ring; save it; inspect recommendation and explore other workshop packages
Expected Business Outcome: Design is saved; recommendation is advisory and no workshop is hidden

Title: Custom design request
Scenario (business language steps): Submit description/images and optionally a non-archived design; wait for Staff/Manager review
Expected Business Outcome: Request status and mandatory explanation are visible to the Member

Title: Clarification and custom order
Scenario (business language steps): Staff requests clarification; Member revises; Staff accepts; Manager approves quote; Member pays full amount
Expected Business Outcome: One custom order completes without cart, deposit or split payment

Title: Public review and Member review
Scenario (business language steps): Guest reads public reviews; Member submits an eligible review and edits it
Expected Business Outcome: Public projection is safe and Member review remains PUBLIC after edit

Title: Design consultation
Scenario (business language steps): Member opens contextless or design-context chat; exchanges messages; closes chat
Expected Business Outcome: UTF-8 history is retained; Staff/Manager permissions and closed state work

Title: Operational role boundary
Scenario (business language steps): Staff reviews in-scope request; Manager approves quote; Admin attempts business mutation
Expected Business Outcome: Staff/Manager actions follow scope and Admin is denied business action
